aspect: It is recognised and named in housing law
description: Letting a property, room or accommodation in return for sexual favours is a recognised form of landlord harassment, framed as quid pro quo - housing benefits offered in exchange.
energy_note: It has a name in the statute and a shortage behind it.

aspect: The power dimension is the point, not desire
description: Housing harassment is characterised as an abuse of power that is not always driven by sexual attraction to the tenant, and can instead be discrimination based on sex.
A deposit, a reference, a month's notice and somewhere else to go - in a market where she is already at the bottom. The exit is priced out of reach, which is the condition being exploited.
energy_note: The door is unlocked and costs four thousand to walk through.

description: Third week without hot water. 'I'll be honest, I've been stretched. Rent's due Friday, isn't it.' A pause. 'Unless we come to something.' He has not said anything. She will not be able to quote a sentence.
energy_note: Nothing said, and she understood it exactly.
